summary.en-US: Keep your bookmarks in YAML files at URLs you choose; Firefox mirrors them. One-way: the files are the source of truth, nothing is ever sent back.

description.en-US:
Write your bookmarks as plain YAML, host the file anywhere reachable over https — a git repo, a web server, a gist — and Bookmarks Mirror keeps Firefox in step with it.

• One-way and read-only: the add-on only fetches; it never uploads or writes back. No account.
• Several files: list more than one URL and they are combined in order.
• Owns only the roots the files name (menu, toolbar, other, mobile); the rest are never touched.
• Validates every file before changing anything: unknown roots, non-web urls and empty roots are refused, and if any file can't be read nothing changes — a broken or truncated file never wipes your bookmarks.
• Host access is requested only for the hosts you list.

Format, rules and source: https://github.com/dbautz/bookmarks-mirror

version.approval_notes:
To test: the settings page opens on install (later: click the toolbar button). Paste https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dbautz/bookmarks-mirror/main/example/bookmarks.yml into the URL box, Save (grants host permission for raw.githubusercontent.com), then Sync now. The Bookmarks Toolbar is replaced by a 'Mirror test' folder and one bookmark; other roots are untouched.

The only network requests are GETs of the user-configured URLs. Source: background.js and options.js are esbuild bundles (unminified) of src/ plus js-yaml 4.3.2 from package-lock.json; the attached source zip rebuilds them with `npm ci && npm run build` (Node 24, npm 11), see README.md.
